newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease firms on strong result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease firms on strong result.

text.p: Shares in financial services and property group Lend Lease Corp Ltd firmed in morning trade after it announced a 14 percent rise in net profit for the six months to December 31.
The A$160 million net profit was at the upper end of market expectations of pre-abnormal net profits of between A$155 million and A$162 million compared with A$140.1 million a year earlier.
"It's at the top end of expectations and, consequently, the market will be happy with it," Intersuisse Head of Equities Andrew Sekely said.
Lend Lease was up 21 cents at A$23.32 at 10.50 a.m. (2350 GMT), having earlier climbed to an intra-day high of A$23.50.
"They're well positioned for continued growth and financial services is a very buoyant sector," Sekely said.
Lend Lease said after its result it was on budget to increase its profit after tax and earnings per share in the full year to June 30, 1997.
It set its interim dividend at 48 cents per share, up from 43 cents a year earlier.
